papers_found.title: Interpretable Company Similarity with Sparse Autoencoders
papers_found.key_finding: SAE on Llama 3.1 8B layer 30 → pairs trading Sharpe 12.18 vs SIC 9.70 vs embeddings 7.58-10.57 on S&P 500 out-of-sample 2014-2020. GitHub + pre-computed HuggingFace features available.

papers_found.title: Corporate Earnings Calls and Analyst Beliefs
papers_found.key_finding: Analysts over-react to optimism, under-react to risk language. Separate scoring: sentiment (30% weight), specificity (50%), risk density inverted (20%). Counterfactual LLM transcripts methodology.

papers_found.title: Retail Investor Horizon and Earnings Announcements
papers_found.relevance: MEDIUM — R34 concept, PEAD signal amplifier
papers_found.key_finding: Long-horizon retail investor composition → pronounced PEAD (0.43%/month zero-cost alpha). Proxy: 13-F institutional ownership percentile (no StockTwits needed).

papers_found.title: AlphaAgents: LLM Multi-Agents for Equity Portfolio Construction
papers_found.key_finding: 3 agents (Fundamental/Sentiment/Valuation) + AutoGen round-robin debate. Multi-agent outperforms single-agent. 4-month backtest only. No code.

papers_found.title: Extracting the Structure of Press Releases for Predicting Earnings Announcement Returns
papers_found.relevance: LOW — PEAD relevance limited (market prices at open)
papers_found.key_finding: FinBERT embeddings on press releases as informative as numeric earnings surprise. But market fully prices this at open — limited PEAD edge.

papers_found.title: Advanced Deep Learning Techniques for Analyzing Earnings Call Transcripts
papers_found.relevance: LOW — survey paper, no new quantitative insights beyond FinBERT baseline
papers_found.key_finding: BERT vs FinBERT vs ULMFiT comparison for earnings transcript sentiment. FinBERT still best for finance domain. No new architecture.

papers_found.title: Financial-RoBERTa-Large
papers_found.relevance: LOW — R31 alternative to FinBERT worth benchmarking
papers_found.key_finding: RoBERTa-Large fine-tuned on 10-K/10-Q/8-K/earnings transcripts/ESG news. Larger than ProsusAI/finbert. May outperform on long documents.
